title: Set in the agent's file
group: Settings of {{name}} that live only in its file
gone: No agent by this name is left on this computer.
noBlock: This file has no settings block at its top (the lines between two --- lines), so these settings cannot be edited here. Edit the file below.
owned: Hoody keeps this agent's file, so these settings cannot be changed.
blocked: The file below has unsaved changes or a save that is not confirmed. Finish there first.
newCopy: This agent has no file of its own yet. Saving a setting creates yours.
ignored: The file has a value here the agent cannot use, so it ignores it and its default applies.
twice: The file sets this on more than one line and the agent uses the last. Remove the extra line in the file below to edit it here.
temperature.label: Temperature
temperature.help: How much replies vary, from 0 (steady) to 2 (varied). Empty uses the model's own.
response_format.label: Reply format
response_format.help: Whether every reply must be a JSON object.
max_steps_per_turn.label: Steps in one turn
max_steps_per_turn.help: The most model requests one of your messages may take. A turn that reaches it ends as failed. Empty means no limit.
compaction_max_tokens.label: Shorten the chat at
compaction_max_tokens.help: History is shortened at this many tokens, or sooner if the model's window needs it. Empty leaves it to the window.
ask_timeout.label: Wait for an answer
ask_timeout.help: How long a helper of this agent waits for an answer: 10m, 1h30m or seconds, up to 24 hours. Empty uses the default.
ask_timeout.field: A time such as 10m, or seconds
bad.tooLow: That is below the lowest value, {{min}}.
bad.tooHigh: That is above the highest value, {{max}}.
bad.notDuration: Type a time such as 10m or 1h30m, or a number of seconds.
saved: Saved to the agent's file. New chats use it.
conflict: The agent's file changed since it was read, so nothing was saved. The values shown are the file's now. Make the change again if it is still needed.
conflict.unread: The agent's file changed since it was read, so nothing was saved, and it could not be read again. Reload to see its values.
refused: The agent did not accept the file, so nothing was written ({{code}}).
refused.unsent: The change was not sent, so nothing was written. You can try again.
cannot: This setting can no longer be edited here, so nothing was written. Edit the file below.
unsure: This may have gone through. The answer to the save did not arrive, and it was not sent again.
unsure.same: The file still reads as it did before the save. The save may still arrive.
unsure.changed: The file reads differently, but not as this save would leave it. The save may still arrive.
unsure.failed: The file could not be read to check. Try Check again in a moment.
unsure.gone: The agent's file is not there now. The save may still arrive.
stop.title: Stop tracking this save?
stop.body: Nothing is sent. The save may still arrive later and change the file. The values shown are the file as last read.
